usageNotes: Use this to disable the cluster-wide HA watchdog stack, typically during planned maintenance or controlled cluster shutdown where HA self-healing would interfere. The `resource-mode` parameter is required: choose `freeze` to pause HA command processing while leaving resources in place, or `ignore` to drop HA tracking entirely so resources can be managed manually. Requires `Sys.Console` on the root path (`/`), which is a privileged permission not granted by default to most API tokens.

examples.summary: Disarm HA in freeze mode before a rolling maintenance window

tips: Use `freeze` when you want to resume HA management after maintenance without reconfiguring resources; use `ignore` only if you intend to manage resources manually for an extended period.
After the maintenance window, re-arm HA via the corresponding arm-ha endpoint to restore watchdog supervision cluster-wide.
Returns null on success — no UPID; the operation is synchronous from the API perspective but watchdog release propagates across cluster nodes asynchronously.
Ensure all cluster nodes are reachable before disarming; a partitioned node may continue its local watchdog behavior independently.
